cards.q: 中世纪欧洲的罚金为何用蜂蜜支付？
cards.short: 森林法允许蜂蜜抵罚金
body: 十一至十三世纪英格兰森林法规定，偷猎、盗伐等轻罪罚金可用蜂蜜抵付，每加仑蜂蜜约合两便士。教会和领主的蜡烛需求使蜂蜜及蜂蜡成为硬通货。
农民缺乏铸币，但养蜂不占耕地且产量稳定。蜂蜜不仅可食用，提炼的蜂蜡供教堂制烛，价值高于等重粮食。森林法接受实物缴纳以确保税收。
并非所有罪行都能用蜂蜜抵罚。谋杀、纵火等重罪必须缴纳金币或牲畜，蜂蜜仅适用于森林内的轻微违法行为。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　中世纪英格兰森林法罚金实物抵付比例
cards.qe: Why were medieval European fines paid in honey?
cards.shorte: Forest law accepted honey as fine payment
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Proportion of forest law fines paid in kind in medieval England
bodye: Between the 11th and 13th centuries, English forest law allowed poaching and logging fines to be paid in honey, valued at about two pence per gallon. Demand from churches and lords for candles made honey and beeswax hard currency.

Peasants lacked coinage but beekeeping required no farmland and yielded steady output. Honey served as food while refined beeswax for church candles held value exceeding equal-weight grain. Forest law accepted goods in kind to ensure revenue.
Not all offenses accepted honey. Murder and arson required coin or livestock; honey applied only to minor forest violations.

cards.q: 落叶为何在秋季变黄而非直接脱落？
cards.short: 叶绿素分解回收氮
body: 树木在落叶前分解叶片中的叶绿素，回收其中的氮、磷等元素转移至枝干储存。叶绿素含镁和氮，分解后黄色类胡萝卜素和花青素显现。一棵成年橡树每年可从落叶回收约2公斤氮。
叶绿素分子在低温和短日照信号下被酶系统拆解，氮以氨基酸形式经叶柄韧皮部运回树干。类胡萝卜素本就存在但被绿色掩盖，花青素则在某些树种中新合成以保护残余光合作用免受强光损伤。
常绿植物也更换叶片，但分批进行且回收期更长，因此不出现集中变色。针叶树的针叶寿命可达数年，落叶时已完成养分转移呈褐色。部分树种如白蜡树在突然降温时来不及回收，叶片带绿脱落。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　叶绿素分解后显现的色素层次示意
cards.qe: Why do leaves turn yellow in autumn instead of dropping directly?
cards.shorte: Chlorophyll breakdown recovers nitrogen
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Pigment layers revealed after chlorophyll degradation
bodye: Trees decompose chlorophyll in leaves before shedding, recovering nitrogen, phosphorus and other elements transferred to branches for storage. Chlorophyll contains magnesium and nitrogen; after breakdown yellow carotenoids and anthocyanins appear. A mature oak recovers about 2 kilograms of nitrogen annually from fallen leaves.

Chlorophyll molecules are dismantled by enzyme systems under low temperature and short daylight signals, with nitrogen transported back through petiole phloem as amino acids. Carotenoids exist but are masked by green; anthocyanins are newly synthesized in some species to protect residual photosynthesis from high light damage.

Evergreens also replace leaves but in batches with longer recovery periods, thus no concentrated color change. Conifer needles last several years, appearing brown when shed after nutrient transfer. Some species like ash drop green leaves when sudden cold prevents timely recovery.

cards.q: 人在太空中身高会增加几厘米？
cards.short: 失重环境下脊柱伸展增高约五厘米
body: 宇航员进入失重环境后身高平均增加五厘米，最多可达七厘米。这一变化在抵达轨道后数小时内发生，返回地球后一至两天内恢复。测量显示躯干长度增加而四肢不变。
地面重力使椎间盘受压缩，其中的髓核被挤压变扁。失重状态下压力消失，椎间盘吸收周围体液膨胀，二十三块椎间盘累积伸展可使脊柱总长度显著增加。同时椎旁肌肉松弛，进一步减少对脊柱的压缩。
这种增高并非益处。椎间盘过度膨胀会压迫神经，约半数宇航员报告腰背疼痛。长期失重还导致椎间盘退化加速，部分宇航员返回后数月仍有椎间盘突出症状。地面上早晨身高也比晚上高约一至二厘米。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　重力与失重状态下脊柱椎间盘形态对比示意图
cards.qe: How many centimeters does height increase in space?
cards.shorte: Spinal elongation adds ~5cm in microgravity
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Schematic comparison of spinal intervertebral discs under gravity vs. microgravity
bodye: Astronauts gain an average of 5 cm in height upon entering microgravity, with some reaching up to 7 cm. This change occurs within hours of reaching orbit and reverses one to two days after returning to Earth. Measurements show trunk elongation with no limb change.

Ground gravity compresses intervertebral discs, squeezing the nucleus pulposus flat. In weightlessness, pressure disappears and discs absorb surrounding fluid to swell. The 23 intervertebral discs cumulatively expand spinal length significantly. Simultaneously, paraspinal muscles relax, further reducing spinal compression.

This height gain brings no benefit. Excessive disc swelling compresses nerves, with about half of astronauts reporting lower back pain. Prolonged microgravity accelerates disc degeneration; some astronauts experience herniation symptoms months after return. On Earth, morning height also exceeds evening by 1-2 cm.

cards.q: 为何哥特式彩绘玻璃窗能保持鲜艳数百年？
cards.short: 金属氧化物混入玻璃体
cards.qe: Why do Gothic stained glass windows stay vibrant for centuries?
cards.shorte: Metal oxides fused in glass body
body: 哥特式彩绘玻璃的颜色来自熔制时混入玻璃体内的金属氧化物，钴产生蓝色，铜产生绿色，金产生红色。这些金属原子分散在玻璃分子网络中，与表面涂料完全不同。现存最古老的彩绘玻璃窗距今超过八百年仍保持原有色彩饱和度。
玻璃本质是冷却速度极快的液体，金属氧化物在高温下与硅酸盐熔体充分混合后被永久锁定在非晶态结构中。这种颜色不存在于表面，而是贯穿整块玻璃的厚度，光线通过时在玻璃内部被选择性吸收或散射，因此不会因风化或摩擦而褪色。
许多人认为彩绘玻璃是在透明玻璃表面绘制而成，但中世纪工匠只在玻璃表面涂绘黑色铁质珐琅来勾勒轮廓和细节，主体色彩全部源自玻璃本身。文艺复兴后期开始流行的釉彩玻璃才采用表面涂料，这类作品往往在两百年内即出现严重褪色和剥落。
bodye: Gothic stained glass derives its color from metal oxides fused into the glass body during melting: cobalt yields blue, copper green, gold red. These metal atoms disperse within the glass molecular network, entirely unlike surface pigments. The oldest surviving stained glass windows retain original color saturation after over eight centuries.

Glass is essentially a supercooled liquid. Metal oxides thoroughly mix with silicate melt at high temperatures and become permanently locked in the amorphous structure. This color permeates the glass thickness rather than residing on the surface. Light passing through undergoes selective absorption or scattering within the glass, rendering it immune to weathering or abrasion.

Many assume stained glass involves painting on clear glass, but medieval craftsmen only applied black iron-based enamel on surfaces to outline contours and details. All primary colors originated from the glass itself. Enameled glass popular after the late Renaissance used surface pigments and typically showed severe fading and flaking within two centuries.

cards.q: 番茄在欧洲曾因何而不敢食用？
cards.short: 番茄与铅中毒误会
body: 十六至十八世纪欧洲，番茄长期被视为有毒植物。记录显示贵族在食用番茄后出现中毒症状，包括恶心、抽搐甚至死亡。平民则因此避免种植和食用，番茄多作观赏用途栽培。
真正原因是锡铅合金餐具。贵族使用的高锡含量盘碟铅占比可达百分之四十，番茄酸性很强，会溶出大量铅离子。平民使用木质或陶制餐具，不会发生这种反应，但他们模仿上层阶级的禁忌。
意大利南部和西班牙部分地区未受此影响，因为当地传统用陶器盛放食物。十九世纪餐具材质改变后，番茄才在北欧广泛进入日常饮食，之前的毒性传说逐渐被遗忘。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　十七世纪锡铅合金餐盘
cards.src: Journal of the History of Medicine and Allied Sciences
cards.qe: Why did Europeans once fear eating tomatoes?
cards.shorte: Tomatoes and lead poisoning myth
bodye: From the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries in Europe, tomatoes were long considered poisonous. Records show aristocrats suffered poisoning symptoms after eating tomatoes, including nausea, convulsions, and death. Commoners avoided cultivation and consumption, growing tomatoes mainly as ornamentals.

The true cause was pewter tableware. Aristocratic high-tin plates contained up to forty percent lead, and tomato acidity leached large amounts of lead ions. Commoners used wooden or ceramic vessels that did not cause this reaction, but they imitated upper-class taboos.

Southern Italy and parts of Spain were unaffected because local tradition used ceramic vessels for food. After nineteenth-century changes in tableware materials, tomatoes entered northern European daily diets widely, and the earlier toxicity legend gradually faded.

cards.q: 绳结为何会自发形成？
cards.short: 绳长超阈值必打结
body: 当绳索长度超过临界值时，随机运动几乎必然形成绳结。2007 年实验显示，将长度 0.5 到 5 米的绳索装入旋转盒中，长度超过 1.5 米时打结概率超过 50%。
绳结形成遵循拓扑学原理。绳索每次弯曲、穿越自身路径都创造拓扑变换机会，长度每增加一倍，可能的交叉点数量呈指数增长，导致绳结形成概率急剧上升。
人们常认为静止放置的绳索不会打结，但研究表明即使轻微振动也足以触发结构重排。航海和攀岩领域专门设计无结绳索存储方法，以对抗这一自然趋势。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　不同长度绳索的打结概率曲线
cards.src: Spontaneous knotting of an agitated string
cards.qe: Why do knots form spontaneously?
cards.shorte: Rope length exceeds threshold
bodye: When rope length exceeds a critical value, random motion almost guarantees knot formation. A 2007 experiment showed that ropes between 0.5 and 5 meters placed in a rotating box had over 50% knotting probability when longer than 1.5 meters.

Knot formation follows topological principles. Each bend and self-crossing creates an opportunity for topological transformation. Doubling the length exponentially increases possible crossing points, sharply raising the probability of knot formation.

People assume stationary ropes won't tangle, but research shows even slight vibration can trigger structural rearrangement. Maritime and climbing communities have developed knot-free storage methods specifically to counter this natural tendency.

cards.q: 为何井盖是圆形而非方形？
cards.short: 圆形井盖无法坠井
body: 圆形井盖无法从井口掉入，因为圆的直径处处相等。方形井盖对角线长度比边长大约 1.4 倍，斜立时可穿过井口。圆形井盖直径略大于井口，任何角度都无法落入。
这一特性源于等宽曲线的几何性质。圆是最简单的等宽图形，任意方向的宽度恒定。其他等宽曲线如勒洛三角形也可用作井盖，但加工成本远高于圆形。
方形井盖并非全无优势，其边缘可与路面平行对齐便于铺设。部分国家采用带凸缘的方形设计，凸缘大于井口防止坠落，但需精确定位增加施工难度。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　圆形与方形井盖相对井口尺寸对比
cards.qe: Why are manhole covers round not square?
cards.shorte: Round covers cannot fall through
bodye: Round manhole covers cannot fall into the opening because a circle has constant diameter. A square cover's diagonal is about 1.4 times its side length, allowing it to pass through the opening when tilted. A round cover's diameter slightly exceeds the opening, preventing entry at any angle.

This property stems from the geometry of curves of constant width. The circle is the simplest constant-width figure, with uniform width in all directions. Other constant-width curves like the Reuleaux triangle could also serve as covers but cost far more to manufacture than circles.

Square covers are not without advantages; their edges align parallel to pavement for easier installation. Some countries use square designs with flanges larger than the opening to prevent falling, but this requires precise positioning and complicates construction.

cards.q: 帕尔马火腿腌制需多长时间？
cards.short: 帕尔马火腿腌制十二个月
body: 意大利帕尔马火腿的最低法定腌制期为 12 个月，高级品种需 24 至 36 个月。整条后腿仅用海盐涂抹后悬挂于通风室内，依靠亚平宁山脉特有的干燥气流缓慢脱水。成品重量约为鲜肉时的 70%。
腌制过程分为盐渍、静置、清洗、风干、涂脂五个阶段。第 7 个月起用猪油混合物封闭切面防止过度干燥，之后转入地窖继续陈化。温度全程控制在 14 至 18 摄氏度之间，湿度随月份调整。
鉴定师会用马骨针刺入火腿五个特定部位，凭气味判断发酵是否均匀。只有产自帕尔马省特定区域、使用当地猪种、符合全部工艺标准的产品才能烙印五角王冠标志。工业速成火腿通常仅需 4 个月。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　帕尔马火腿腌制车间的悬挂排列
cards.src: 帕尔马火腿保护联盟生产规范
cards.qe: How long does Parma ham curing take?
cards.shorte: Parma ham cured for twelve months
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Hanging arrangement in Parma ham curing chamber
bodye: Italian Parma ham has a legal minimum curing period of 12 months, with premium varieties requiring 24 to 36 months. Whole hind legs are rubbed with sea salt only, then hung in ventilated rooms relying on the Apennine Mountains' dry air for gradual dehydration. Finished weight is about 70% of fresh meat.

Curing proceeds through five stages: salting, resting, washing, air-drying, and greasing. From month seven onward, a lard mixture seals cut surfaces to prevent excessive drying, followed by cellar aging. Temperature stays between 14 and 18 degrees Celsius throughout, with humidity adjusted monthly.

Inspectors insert horse-bone needles into five specific points, judging fermentation uniformity by scent. Only products from Parma province's designated zones, using local pig breeds and meeting all process standards, receive the five-pointed crown stamp. Industrial fast-cured hams typically need just 4 months.

cards.q: 斯德哥尔摩地铁站为何装饰得像洞穴？
cards.short: 斯德哥尔摩地铁保留天然岩壁作装饰
body: 斯德哥尔摩约 90 座地铁站中有 47 座直接开凿于基岩内，深度可达地下 30 米。工程师决定不覆盖岩壁，而是喷涂防水材料后由艺术家在粗糙表面绘制壁画或雕塑，形成洞穴般视觉。
1950 年代设计者认为保留自然岩石纹理比铺设瓷砖更经济且富表现力。后续扩建延续这一传统，邀请超过 150 位艺术家参与创作，主题涵盖神话、历史与抽象图案。
岩壁并非完全未处理。施工时需钻孔植入锚杆稳定松动岩块，喷射混凝土封闭裂隙，再施加防水涂层。艺术装饰在结构安全完成后进行，部分站点还安装彩色照明强化效果。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　斯德哥尔摩 T-Centralen 站蓝色岩壁与装饰
cards.qe: Why are Stockholm metro stations decorated like caves?
cards.shorte: Stockholm metro keeps natural rock walls as decor
bodye: Of Stockholm's roughly 90 metro stations, 47 are carved directly into bedrock up to 30 meters underground. Engineers chose not to clad the rock, instead waterproofing it and inviting artists to paint murals or install sculptures on the rough surfaces, creating a cave-like appearance.

1950s planners deemed preserving natural rock texture more economical and expressive than tiling. Subsequent expansions continued this tradition, engaging over 150 artists to create works on themes from mythology to abstraction.

The rock is not left untreated. Construction involves drilling anchor bolts to stabilize loose blocks, spraying shotcrete to seal fissures, and applying waterproof coatings. Artistic decoration follows structural work; some stations add colored lighting for emphasis.

cards.q: 阿拉伯语为何不标元音？
cards.short: 阿拉伯文字省略短元音
body: 阿拉伯文字书写时通常省略短元音，仅标注辅音字母。儿童教材和《古兰经》会用附加符号（哈拉卡特）标注全部元音，但日常印刷品和手写文本均省略这些符号，读者需依靠词根和上下文推断发音。
闪米特语族的词汇以三个辅音构成词根，元音变化用于派生词形和语法功能。辅音框架已足够表达核心意义，母语者能从词根识别词义，即使不标元音也可理解文本。这种特征使文字系统得以简化。
这并非阿拉伯语独有。希伯来语、阿拉姆语等闪米特语言的书写系统同样省略大部分元音。非母语学习者常因此误读单词，但对母语者而言，省略元音反而加快书写和阅读速度。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　阿拉伯字母表，不含独立元音字母
cards.qe: Why doesn't Arabic writing mark vowels?
cards.shorte: Arabic script omits short vowels
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Arabic alphabet without independent vowel letters
bodye: Arabic script typically omits short vowels, marking only consonants. Children's books and the Quran use diacritics (harakat) to indicate all vowels, but everyday printed matter and handwriting omit these marks. Readers infer pronunciation from word roots and context.

Semitic language vocabulary is built on three-consonant roots. Vowel changes derive word forms and grammatical functions. The consonant framework conveys core meaning, allowing native speakers to recognize words even without vowels. This feature enables simplified writing systems.

This is not unique to Arabic. Hebrew, Aramaic, and other Semitic languages employ writing systems that omit most vowels. Non-native learners often misread words, but for native speakers, omitting vowels actually accelerates writing and reading.

cards.q: 十八世纪伦敦街头谁来收集狗粪？
cards.short: 狗粪用于鞣制皮革
body: 十八世纪伦敦街道有专门的拾粪人收集狗粪，他们被称为纯粹工。这些人通常是贫困妇女或儿童，用桶和铲在街巷搜寻，每天可收集数公斤，卖给制革厂换取微薄收入。
狗粪含有胰酶和细菌，能分解动物皮上的毛发和脂肪，使皮革变得柔软细腻。制革厂将粪便加水稀释制成浸液，把生皮浸泡数月进行鞣制。这种方法比植物鞣料处理速度更快，成为当时重要的工艺环节。
纯粹工并非官方雇佣，而是依靠市场需求自发形成的职业。狗粪价格随制革业兴衰波动，高峰期每桶可卖到数先令。十九世纪后化学鞣剂逐渐取代粪便，这一行业才彻底消失。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　伦敦街头拾粪人的版画记录
cards.src: London Labour and the London Poor
cards.qe: Who collected dog feces on 18th-century London streets?
cards.shorte: Dog feces for leather tanning
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ. Engraving of a pure-finder in London streets
bodye: Eighteenth-century London streets had specialized collectors of dog feces called pure-finders. These were typically impoverished women or children who scoured alleys with buckets and shovels, gathering several kilograms daily to sell to tanneries for meager income.

Dog feces contains enzymes and bacteria that break down hair and fat on animal hides, making leather soft and supple. Tanneries diluted the waste with water to create soaking solutions, immersing raw hides for months in the tanning process. This method worked faster than vegetable tannins and became a crucial industrial step.

Pure-finders were not officially employed but formed a profession driven by market demand. Dog feces prices fluctuated with the tanning industry, reaching several shillings per bucket at peak times. The trade vanished completely after chemical tanning agents replaced feces in the nineteenth century.

cards.q: 橄榄油为何不能反复加热？
cards.short: 橄榄油反复加热劣化
body: 橄榄油加热至 180 摄氏度时，每次加热使游离脂肪酸含量增加约 0.3%，反复加热三次后酸价可从初榨的 0.8% 升至 1.7%，超过国际标准的安全阈值 1.0%。
高温使甘油三酯水解释放脂肪酸，同时氧化反应产生醛类和酮类化合物。橄榄油中不饱和脂肪酸占 75%，其双键结构在热和氧气作用下易断裂，生成刺激性挥发物和聚合物。游离脂肪酸降低烟点，加速进一步分解。
精炼橄榄油耐热性优于初榨，因抗氧化剂多酚含量较低但杂质更少。用于油炸的橄榄油应控制温度不超过 170 摄氏度，且单次使用时间不超过 8 小时。颜色从金黄变为深褐是劣化的可见指标。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　橄榄油加热次数与游离脂肪酸增长
cards.qe: Why should olive oil not be reheated repeatedly?
cards.shorte: Repeated heating degrades olive oil
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Free fatty acids in olive oil after reheating cycles
bodye: Heating olive oil to 180°C adds roughly 0.3% free fatty acids per cycle; after three rounds, acidity can climb from virgin oil's 0.8% to 1.7%, exceeding the international safety threshold of 1.0%.

Heat hydrolyzes triglycerides into fatty acids while oxidation generates aldehydes and ketones. Olive oil is 75% unsaturated, with double bonds that break under heat and oxygen, forming irritants and polymers. Free fatty acids lower the smoke point, accelerating further breakdown.

Refined olive oil withstands heat better than virgin because it has fewer polyphenols but also fewer impurities. For frying, keep olive oil below 170°C and use no longer than 8 hours in a single session. A shift from golden to dark brown signals degradation.

cards.q: 罗马竞技场角斗士来自哪里？
cards.short: 战俘和罪犯充当角斗士
body: 公元一至二世纪罗马帝国角斗士约 60% 来自战俘，20% 为被判刑的罪犯，余下为自愿签约者。战俘经过筛选后送入角斗士学校训练，存活率取决于技能和运气，年均出战约三至五场。
战俘角斗士并非随意送死。训练和装备成本高昂，组织者倾向于延长其职业生涯以收回投资。熟练角斗士可获得奖金和自由承诺，部分人在数年后赎身退役。死亡率约为每场 10% 至 20%。
自愿角斗士多为破产自由民，签约换取食宿和收入分成。他们法律地位低于奴隶，但可通过胜利积累财富。少数女性角斗士见于记录，公元二世纪塞普提米乌斯皇帝曾颁布禁令。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　罗马角斗士浮雕，显示不同类型装备与战斗姿态
cards.qe: Where did Roman Colosseum gladiators come from?
cards.shorte: Captives and convicts as gladiators
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Roman gladiator relief showing equipment types and combat postures
bodye: In the 1st to 2nd centuries CE, about 60% of Roman gladiators were war captives, 20% convicted criminals, and the rest voluntary contractors. Captives were screened and sent to gladiator schools for training. Survival depended on skill and luck; fighters averaged three to five bouts yearly.

Captive gladiators were not disposable. Training and equipment costs were high; organizers preferred prolonging careers to recoup investment. Skilled fighters earned bonuses and freedom promises; some bought liberty after years. Mortality was roughly 10-20% per bout.

Voluntary gladiators were often bankrupt freemen, signing contracts for lodging and revenue shares. Their legal status fell below slaves, but victories could accumulate wealth. A few female gladiators appear in records; Emperor Septimius Severus issued a ban in the 2nd century.

cards.q: 凡尔赛宫镜厅的镜子是如何运抵的？
cards.short: 镜厅镜子由骡队翻阿尔卑斯山运抵
body: 凡尔赛宫镜厅的 357 面镜子于 1678 年至 1684 年间由威尼斯秘密制造，每面高约 1.8 米。这些镜子需从威尼斯运至巴黎，但当时水路运输风险极高，玻璃易碎，因此选择陆路。
骡队翻越阿尔卑斯山成为主要运输方式。每面镜子用木箱包裹，内衬干草和羊毛，由专人押运。山路崎岖且气候多变，行程耗时数月，损耗率约达百分之二十。
威尼斯当时垄断欧洲镜子制造，严禁工匠外流和技术泄露。法国国王路易十四派人诱使威尼斯工匠偷渡至法国，建立本土镜子工坊，打破了威尼斯的垄断地位。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　阿尔卑斯山骡队运输路线示意
cards.qe: How were the mirrors of Versailles Hall of Mirrors transported?
cards.shorte: Mirrors carried by mules over the Alps
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Mule train route across the Alps
bodye: The 357 mirrors in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles, each about 1.8 meters tall, were secretly manufactured in Venice between 1678 and 1684. Water transport posed extreme risk to the fragile glass, so overland routes were chosen.

Mule trains crossing the Alps became the primary method. Each mirror was crated in wood, cushioned with hay and wool, and escorted by guards. The mountain journey took months, with a loss rate around twenty percent.

Venice then monopolized European mirror-making and forbade craftsmen from leaving. King Louis XIV lured Venetian artisans to France to establish domestic workshops, breaking Venice's stranglehold on the trade.

cards.q: 为什么钟表上12个数字的和恰好是78？
cards.short: 钟面数字和为78无特殊含义
body: 钟表刻度1到12的总和为78，这是等差数列求和的结果。计算公式为(1+12)×12÷2=78，与钟表设计无关，仅因古巴比伦人将圆周分为360度后，12这个因数被广泛使用。
12被选为钟面刻度数量，源于其可被2、3、4、6整除的特性，便于划分时间。巴比伦人使用六十进制计数，60可被12整除，这种便利性延续至今日时间系统。78这个总和本身不具备任何时间计量意义。
有人认为78与某些神秘学数字相关，实为附会。任何连续自然数序列都有确定的和，如1到10的和是55，1到20的和是210。钟面数字和只是数学必然，非设计初衷。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　1 至 12 数字总和的几何推导
cards.qe: Why do the 12 numbers on a clock face add up to 78?
cards.shorte: Clock numerals sum to 78 by arithmetic
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ. Geometric derivation of sum from 1 to 12
bodye: The sum of clock numerals 1 to 12 equals 78, a result of arithmetic series formula (1+12)×12÷2=78. This has no connection to clock design but stems from Babylonian division of circles into 360 degrees, making 12 a common divisor.

Twelve was chosen for clock divisions due to divisibility by 2, 3, 4, and 6, facilitating time segmentation. Babylonians used base-60 counting, with 60 divisible by 12, a convenience persisting in modern timekeeping. The sum 78 itself holds no temporal significance.

Some claim 78 relates to numerological mysticism, but this is false attribution. Any consecutive natural number sequence has a determined sum: 1 to 10 equals 55, 1 to 20 equals 210. The clock face sum is mathematical inevitability, not intentional design.

cards.q: 钻石在紫外光下为何会发光？
cards.short: 多数钻石紫外光下发荧光
cards.qe: Why do diamonds glow under ultraviolet light?
cards.shorte: Most diamonds fluoresce under UV
body: 约 35% 的天然钻石在长波紫外光照射下发出蓝色荧光，少数呈现黄色或绿色。这种现象与钻石晶格中的杂质原子有关，纯净的碳晶体本身不发光。
氮原子取代晶格中的碳原子后，形成特定的电子能级结构。紫外光子激发这些能级上的电子，电子返回基态时释放可见光波段的光子。发光颜色取决于氮原子的聚集方式和浓度。
荧光并非钻石品质的负面指标。强荧光钻石在日光下可能显得略微浑浊，但在紫外光源密集的环境中反而更明亮。人造钻石通常缺乏天然钻石的氮杂质，因此荧光特征可用于鉴定。
bodye: Approximately 35% of natural diamonds emit blue fluorescence under long-wave UV light, with some showing yellow or green. This phenomenon relates to impurity atoms in the crystal lattice; pure carbon crystals do not luminesce.

Nitrogen atoms replacing carbon in the lattice create specific electronic energy levels. UV photons excite electrons at these levels; returning electrons release visible-wavelength photons. Emission color depends on nitrogen clustering patterns and concentration.

Fluorescence is not a quality defect. Strongly fluorescent diamonds may appear slightly hazy in daylight but become brighter under UV-rich lighting. Synthetic diamonds typically lack natural nitrogen impurities, making fluorescence a useful authentication marker.
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　天然钻石在紫外光下的蓝色荧光对比
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Blue fluorescence of natural diamond under UV light
cards.src: 《宝石学与矿物学》荧光钻石分析

cards.q: 成人肺泡展开后总面积约多大？
cards.short: 肺泡展开面积 70 平方米
body: 成人双肺约含 3 到 5 亿个肺泡，单个肺泡直径约 0.2 到 0.3 毫米。若将所有肺泡表面完全展开，总面积约 70 平方米，相当于一个羽毛球场大小，而肺本身体积仅约 5 到 6 升。
肺泡壁厚度仅 0.2 到 0.5 微米，由单层扁平上皮细胞构成，与毛细血管壁共同形成气血屏障。巨大表面积和极薄屏障使氧气和二氧化碳可在不到 1 秒内完成交换。
肺气肿患者肺泡壁破裂融合，虽然总体积增大，但有效交换面积反而减少 30% 以上。表面活性剂缺乏会导致肺泡塌陷，新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征即由此引起。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　肺泡结构与毛细血管网扫描电镜图
cards.qe: What is the total surface area of adult alveoli when unfolded?
cards.shorte: Alveolar surface area: 70 sq meters
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Scanning electron micrograph of alveolar structure and capillary network
bodye: Adult lungs contain approximately 300 to 500 million alveoli, each about 0.2 to 0.3 millimeters in diameter. If completely unfolded, total alveolar surface area reaches about 70 square meters, equivalent to a badminton court, while lung volume is only 5 to 6 liters.

Alveolar walls are just 0.2 to 0.5 micrometers thick, composed of a single layer of squamous epithelial cells that form the air-blood barrier with capillary walls. This vast surface area and thin barrier enable oxygen and carbon dioxide exchange in under 1 second.

Emphysema patients experience alveolar wall rupture and fusion; though total volume increases, effective exchange area decreases by over 30%. Surfactant deficiency causes alveolar collapse, the mechanism behind neonatal respiratory distress syndrome.

cards.q: 新鲜竹笋需要煮多久才能安全食用？
cards.short: 新鲜竹笋需煮半小时去毒
body: 新鲜竹笋含有氰苷类化合物，摄入后在体内可转化为氢氰酸。生食 200 至 300 克未处理竹笋可能引起中毒症状。不同品种氰苷含量差异显著，苦竹笋含量可达甜竹笋的数倍。
氰苷类物质不稳定，在沸水中加热 30 分钟以上可分解挥发。煮制过程中需敞开锅盖，让氢氰酸随蒸汽散出。传统做法常先切片焯水再烹饪，双重处理进一步降低残留。
超市售卖的袋装水煮笋已完成脱毒处理，可直接烹调。但农家自挖春笋若仅快速翻炒，氰苷未充分分解仍有风险。古籍中记载竹笋需久煮，并非为了口感而是经验性的安全措施。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　不同烹煮时间下竹笋氰苷残留量变化曲线

cards.qe: How long must fresh bamboo shoots be boiled to be safe to eat?
cards.shorte: Bamboo shoots need 30-min boil
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Cyanogenic glycoside degradation curve in bamboo shoots at different boiling durations
bodye: Fresh bamboo shoots contain cyanogenic glycosides that convert to hydrogen cyanide in the body. Consuming 200 to 300 grams of untreated shoots may cause poisoning symptoms. Cyanide levels vary significantly among species, with bitter varieties containing several times more than sweet ones.

Cyanogenic compounds are heat-labile and decompose after boiling for over 30 minutes. Cooking with the lid off allows hydrogen cyanide to escape with steam. Traditional methods often involve slicing and blanching before cooking, providing dual treatment to reduce residues.

Pre-packaged boiled shoots sold in supermarkets have completed detoxification and can be cooked directly. However, freshly dug spring shoots that are only stir-fried briefly may retain unsafe cyanide levels. Ancient texts recommending prolonged boiling reflect empirical safety practices, not mere texture preferences.

cards.q: 传统酱油酿造需要多少个昼夜？
cards.short: 传统酱油酿造需约半年
body: 传统酿造酱油从制曲到发酵成熟通常需要 180 天左右。大豆小麦混合制曲需 3 至 5 天，随后拌盐水入缸发酵，夏季高温时约需 5 个月，冬季可延长至 8 个月。日本传统酱油酿造周期可达一年以上。
发酵过程分为三个阶段：前期米曲霉分解淀粉蛋白质，中期乳酸菌和酵母菌繁殖产酸产醇，后期各类代谢产物缓慢聚合形成特有风味。温度、盐度、翻醅频率都影响最终品质，工艺无法大幅压缩。
现代工业酱油通过加温加菌种可将周期缩短至 1 至 3 个月，但风味复杂度不及传统酿造。配制酱油用酸水解植物蛋白液勾兑，数日即成，但缺乏发酵酱油的酯香和氨基酸谱系。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　传统酱油酿造各阶段时间分配
cards.src: 《中国调味品》传统酿造酱油工艺
cards.qe: How many days and nights does traditional soy sauce brewing require?
cards.shorte: Traditional soy sauce takes 6 months
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Time allocation across traditional soy sauce brewing stages
bodye: Traditional brewed soy sauce typically requires about 180 days from koji preparation to fermentation maturity. Soybean-wheat koji making takes 3 to 5 days, followed by salted fermentation in vats for around 5 months in summer heat or up to 8 months in winter. Japanese traditional brewing can extend beyond one year.

Fermentation proceeds in three phases: early-stage Aspergillus oryzae breaks down starch and protein, mid-stage lactic acid bacteria and yeast proliferate producing acids and alcohols, late-stage metabolites slowly polymerize forming distinctive flavors. Temperature, salinity, and turning frequency affect final quality, with no way to substantially compress the timeline.

Modern industrial soy sauce uses heating and starter cultures to shorten cycles to 1 to 3 months, but flavor complexity falls short of traditional brewing. Blended soy sauce uses acid-hydrolyzed vegetable protein liquid mixed in days, lacking the ester aromas and amino acid profiles of fermented products.

cards.q: 巴黎地下采石场挖空了多少公里？
cards.short: 巴黎地下采石场长达三百公里
body: 巴黎地下采石场总长度约三百公里，深度在地表下五至三十五米。从十二世纪起持续开采石灰岩用于地面建筑，形成大面积空洞。十八世纪末塌方事故频发，迫使政府设立采石场巡查局加固隧道。
开采集中在左岸与郊区，因该处地质为始新世石灰岩层，质地均匀易切割。工人沿岩层水平开凿，留下支撑柱，形成棋盘状地下空间。废弃后部分隧道改为藏骨堂，容纳约六百万具骸骨。
巴黎地铁与地下采石场并不重叠，地铁隧道深度通常浅于采石场。现代建筑施工前需探测地下空洞并注浆填充，避免沉降。游客开放区域仅占总长度不到百分之一。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　巴黎地下采石场隧道剖面示意，可见支撑柱与岩层结构
cards.src: Inspection Générale des Carrières 年度报告
cards.qe: How many kilometers of quarries lie beneath Paris?
cards.shorte: Paris quarries span 300 km underground
bodye: The quarries beneath Paris total approximately 300 kilometers in length, at depths of 5 to 35 meters below surface. Limestone extraction began in the 12th century to supply building material, creating vast voids. By the late 18th century, frequent collapses led authorities to establish the Inspection of Quarries to reinforce tunnels.

Mining concentrated in the Left Bank and suburbs, where Eocene limestone layers offered uniform, easily cut stone. Workers excavated horizontally along strata, leaving support pillars in a grid pattern. Abandoned sections were later converted into ossuaries holding around six million skeletal remains.

Paris Metro tunnels do not overlap with quarries; metro lines typically run shallower. Modern construction requires void detection and grouting to prevent subsidence. The publicly accessible tourist zone represents less than one percent of total length.

cards.q: 汉字在越南废止后多久重新出现？
cards.short: 汉字在越南未完全废止
body: 越南 1945 年独立后逐步推广拉丁字母国语字，1954 年北方政府正式废止汉字教学，南方至 1975 年统一后跟进。但汉字从未在民间彻底消失，寺庙碑文、族谱、中药方、春联中持续使用长达数十年。
废止汉字是去殖民化的一部分。汉字在越南使用超过两千年，喃字（本土汉字变体）曾与汉字并行。拉丁字母国语字原为 17 世纪传教士创制，20 世纪被赋予民族独立象征意义，最终取代汉字成为官方文字。
近年越南重新将汉字纳入部分中学选修课程。这并非复古，而是因大量历史文献、建筑铭文用汉字书写，文化遗产研究需要解读能力。同时与中国经贸往来增加，汉字作为实用技能重获关注。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　河内文庙碑文，汉字与喃字混用刻石
cards.src: Chữ Nôm: The Demotic System of Writing in Vietnam
cards.qe: How long after abolishing Chinese characters did Vietnam bring them back?
cards.shorte: Chinese characters never fully abolished in Vietnam
bodye: After independence in 1945, Vietnam gradually promoted Latin-script Quốc ngữ. Northern government officially abolished Chinese character education in 1954; the South followed suit after unification in 1975. Yet Chinese characters never disappeared from temples, genealogies, herbal prescriptions, and Tết couplets for decades.

Abolishing Chinese characters was part of decolonization. Used in Vietnam for over two millennia, Chinese characters coexisted with Chữ Nôm, indigenous character variants. Latin-script Quốc ngữ, created by 17th-century missionaries, became a symbol of national independence in the 20th century and replaced Chinese characters as official script.

Recent years have seen Chinese characters reintroduced in some secondary schools as electives. This is not nostalgia but necessity: vast historical documents and architectural inscriptions require literacy for heritage research. Growing trade with China has also renewed interest in Chinese characters as a practical skill.

cards.q: 玻璃窗反射掉多少比例的光？
cards.short: 普通玻璃反射百分之八光线
body: 普通透明玻璃窗在垂直入射时，反射约百分之八的可见光，其中每个玻璃表面反射百分之四。透射率约为百分之九十，剩余百分之二被玻璃材料吸收。
反射率由玻璃与空气的折射率差决定。玻璃折射率约为1.5，空气约为1.0，根据菲涅耳公式计算得出单表面反射率。双层玻璃窗因有四个界面，反射率更高。
增透膜技术可将反射率降至百分之一以下。博物馆展柜常用低反射玻璃以减少眩光。角度越大反射率越高，斜视玻璃窗时可见自己的镜像更清晰。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　光线通过玻璃的折射与反射路径
cards.qe: What percentage of light does a glass window reflect?
cards.shorte: Ordinary glass reflects 8% of light
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Light refraction and reflection paths through glass
bodye: Ordinary transparent glass window reflects approximately 8% of visible light at perpendicular incidence, with each glass surface reflecting 4%. Transmission rate is about 90%, with the remaining 2% absorbed by the glass material.

Reflectance is determined by the refractive index difference between glass and air. Glass has a refractive index of about 1.5, air about 1.0, yielding single-surface reflectance calculated via Fresnel equations. Double-pane windows have higher reflectance due to four interfaces.

Anti-reflective coating can reduce reflectance to below 1%. Museum display cases often use low-reflection glass to minimize glare. Reflectance increases with viewing angle; oblique viewing produces clearer mirror images.

cards.q: 罗马角斗士一年参加几场实战比赛？
cards.short: 角斗士年出战约三至五场
body: 罗马角斗士平均每年仅参加三至五场实战比赛，而非每日厮杀。庞贝角斗士营地的训练记录显示，职业角斗士每场比赛后需三至四个月恢复期。一线角斗士职业生涯约十至十五场比赛。
角斗士是昂贵资产，训练一名熟练角斗士需两至三年，成本相当于四名奴隶。主办方为降低损失，比赛多以一方认输告终，死亡率约为百分之十至二十。医疗团队包括专职外科医生。
大量壁画描绘的血腥场面多为死刑犯处决，而非职业角斗。公元一世纪后，角斗士工会甚至规定了最低出场费和休息期。退役角斗士可获自由身，部分成为训练师，月薪达普通士兵三倍。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　庞贝角斗士营地出土的全年赛程记录残片
cards.qe: How many real fights did a Roman gladiator have per year?
cards.shorte: Gladiators fought 3-5 bouts yearly
bodye: Roman gladiators averaged only three to five real fights per year, not daily combat. Training records from Pompeii gladiator barracks show professional fighters required three to four months recovery per bout. Career totals ranged from ten to fifteen fights.

Gladiators were costly assets requiring two to three years training, equivalent to four slave prices. To minimize losses, most bouts ended in surrender with 10-20% mortality. Medical teams included dedicated surgeons.

Bloody murals often depicted criminal executions rather than professional bouts. By the 1st century CE, gladiator guilds regulated minimum fees and rest periods. Retired fighters gained freedom, some becoming trainers earning triple a legionary's salary.

cards.q: 为何戏曲演员靠旗代表千军万马？
cards.short: 靠旗通过程式化动作象征军队
body: 中国戏曲舞台通常不超过 100 平方米，无法容纳大规模军队场面。演员背后插四面三角形靠旗，高约 2 米，通过特定舞蹈动作和队形变化，象征指挥千军万马的将领身份。
靠旗与身体固定在靠甲上，演员转身、蹲起或奔跑时旗帜随之摆动，产生动态视觉效果。观众通过程式化的舞蹈语汇理解旗帜的象征意义，而非写实的军队再现。这种虚拟化手法是戏曲美学的核心原则。
靠旗最初源自宋代武将实战装备中的认旗，用于战场识别身份。明清戏曲将其简化为装饰性道具，颜色和数量根据角色地位调整。现代京剧《霸王别项》中项羽背插四面黄旗，即为此传统的延续。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　京剧武生靠旗装束，展示背部四面三角旗
cards.qe: Why do opera performers use back flags to represent armies?
cards.shorte: Back flags symbolize troops through stylized movement
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ Peking Opera martial role costume showing four triangular back flags
bodye: Traditional Chinese opera stages typically measure under 100 square meters, unable to accommodate large military scenes. Performers wear four triangular flags on their backs, approximately 2 meters tall, using specific dance movements and formations to symbolize generals commanding vast armies.

Flags attach to armor frames and move with the performer's turns, crouches, and runs, creating dynamic visual effects. Audiences understand the symbolic meaning through codified dance vocabulary rather than literal depiction. This abstraction is central to opera aesthetics.

Back flags originated from Song dynasty identification banners worn by generals in battle. Ming and Qing opera simplified them into decorative props, with colors and quantities adjusted by rank. In modern productions like Farewell My Concubine, Xiang Yu wears four yellow flags continuing this tradition.
cards.query: Peking Opera kao qi back flags costume martial role

cards.q: 贝多芬耳聋后如何创作交响曲？
cards.short: 贝多芬用音乐记忆与理论作曲
body: 贝多芬从 28 岁开始听力衰退，44 岁时已完全失聪。他在此后创作了《第九交响曲》等重要作品，总数超过 40 部。他通过咬住木棍抵在钢琴上感受振动，以及依靠此前积累的音乐记忆与和声理论进行创作。
音乐家的内心听觉能力可独立于实际听力运作。贝多芬能在脑海中想象音色、和声与配器效果，将这些内在声音记录为乐谱。他的手稿显示大量修改痕迹，证明他通过视觉检查乐谱的逻辑结构，而非依赖听觉试奏。
首演《第九交响曲》时，贝多芬背对乐队指挥，实际指挥由另一位音乐家担任。演出结束后他仍未察觉观众起立鼓掌，直到女高音歌手转过他的身体，他才看见全场喝彩。这一幕被记录在多位在场者的回忆录中。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　贝多芬第九交响曲手稿页，展示密集的修改标记
cards.qe: How did Beethoven compose symphonies after going deaf?
cards.shorte: Beethoven used musical memory and theory to compose
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ Manuscript page of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony showing extensive revisions
bodye: Beethoven's hearing began deteriorating at 28 and was completely lost by 44. He subsequently composed Symphony No. 9 and over 40 other major works. He bit wooden sticks pressed against the piano to feel vibrations and relied on accumulated musical memory and harmonic theory.

Inner hearing can operate independently of physical audition. Beethoven imagined timbre, harmony, and orchestration in his mind, transcribing these internal sounds as notation. His manuscripts show extensive revisions, indicating he checked score logic visually rather than through auditory trial.

At the premiere of Symphony No. 9, Beethoven stood with his back to the orchestra while another conductor led. After the performance he remained unaware of the standing ovation until a soprano turned him around to see the audience. This moment appears in multiple eyewitness accounts.
cards.query: Beethoven Symphony No 9 manuscript autograph score

cards.q: 巴黎协和广场方尖碑为何没有碑尖？
cards.short: 卢克索方尖碑原碑尖已遗失
body: 协和广场的卢克索方尖碑顶端是 1998 年加装的镀金金字塔尖，而非原物。这座公元前 13 世纪的方尖碑 1831 年从埃及运抵巴黎时已缺失碑尖，原尖下落不明。
古埃及方尖碑的碑尖通常用青铜或金合金制成，称为 benben，象征太阳光芒。原尖可能在古代被盗熔或毁于战乱，碑身运抵法国后顶部平整切割以便竖立。
法国政府用铜制金字塔尖替代原物，表面镀金以模拟原貌。碑尖高 3.6 米，重约 750 公斤，内部装有避雷针。埃及官方未要求归还碑尖或补全。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　协和广场卢克索方尖碑与镀金碑尖
cards.qe: Why does the Place de la Concorde obelisk lack its tip?
cards.shorte: Luxor obelisk's original tip is missing
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Luxor Obelisk at Place de la Concorde with gilded tip
bodye: The gilded pyramidion atop the Luxor Obelisk at Place de la Concorde was added in 1998, not original. The 13th-century BCE obelisk arrived in Paris in 1831 already missing its tip, whereabouts unknown.

Ancient Egyptian obelisk tips, called benben, were typically bronze or gold alloy, symbolizing sun rays. The original may have been looted for metal or destroyed in antiquity. The shaft's top was trimmed flat for erection in France.

France installed a copper pyramidion, gilded to approximate the original. The 3.6-meter tip weighs about 750 kilograms and houses a lightning rod. Egyptian authorities have not requested return or completion.
cards.query: Luxor Obelisk Place de la Concorde photograph

cards.q: 铁轨下为何要铺碎石而非水泥？
cards.short: 碎石道床排水减震
body: 铁路道床铺设的碎石称为道砟，粒径通常在二到六厘米之间。全球约百分之八十的铁路采用碎石道床，每公里用量达一千五百吨。
碎石间的孔隙可快速排出雨水，防止轨枕下积水冻胀。列车通过时，碎石间的摩擦与位移吸收振动能量，减少对路基的冲击。碎石还允许轨道位置微调，维护时无需大规模施工。
高速铁路和地铁常采用无砟轨道，用混凝土整体道床替代碎石。虽然初期造价高三到五倍，但使用寿命长达六十年，维护成本远低于碎石道床。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　铁路道砟碎石颗粒特写
cards.qe: Why are railway tracks laid on gravel rather than concrete?
cards.shorte: Gravel ballast drains and dampens
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Close-up of railway ballast gravel particles
bodye: Railway track ballast consists of crushed stone with particle sizes typically between 2 and 6 centimeters. Approximately 80% of global railways use gravel ballast, consuming about 1,500 tons per kilometer.

Voids between stones rapidly drain rainwater, preventing waterlogging and frost heave beneath sleepers. When trains pass, friction and displacement between stones absorb vibrational energy, reducing impact on the roadbed. Gravel also permits fine track position adjustments without major construction during maintenance.

High-speed railways and subways often use ballastless track, replacing gravel with monolithic concrete slabs. Though initial costs run three to five times higher, service life reaches sixty years with far lower maintenance costs than gravel ballast.

cards.q: 国际象棋盘上放多少粒米可超全球年产量？
cards.short: 棋盘填满米粒总数超全球年产量
body: 国际象棋盘有 64 个格子。若第一格放 1 粒米，第二格放 2 粒，第三格放 4 粒，依此类推每格翻倍，填满棋盘需要约 1.8×10¹⁹ 粒米，总重量超过 4600 亿吨，远超全球稻米年产量约 5 亿吨。
这是几何级数增长的结果。前半盘（32 格）看似不多，总和仅约 43 亿粒，但后半盘每格数量都超过前面所有格子的总和。第 64 格单格需要约 9.2×10¹⁸ 粒，占总数一半以上。
这个问题源自古印度传说：发明国际象棋的人向国王要求以此方式赏米，国王轻易答应后发现无法兑现。指数增长在日常生活中不易察觉，但在复利计算、病毒传播和计算机存储容量等领域有实际意义。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　棋盘格数与累计米粒数量的指数增长
cards.qe: How many chessboard squares filled with rice exceed global production?
cards.shorte: Filling chessboard with doubling rice exceeds world output
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ. Exponential growth of rice grains across chessboard
bodye: A chessboard has 64 squares. Starting with 1 grain on the first square, 2 on the second, 4 on the third, doubling each time, filling the board requires about 1.8×10¹⁹ grains, weighing over 460 billion tons, far exceeding global annual rice production of about 500 million tons.

This results from geometric progression. The first half (32 squares) seems modest, totaling only about 4.3 billion grains, but each square in the second half exceeds the sum of all previous squares. Square 64 alone requires about 9.2×10¹⁸ grains, over half the total.

This problem originates from an ancient Indian legend: a chess inventor requested this rice reward from a king, who agreed readily before realizing impossibility. Exponential growth is hard to perceive in daily life but has practical implications in compound interest, virus spread, and computer storage capacity.

cards.q: 蒙古马一天能换多少次骑手？
cards.short: 蒙古骑兵靠换马而非换人接力
body: 蒙古军队的快速机动依靠每名骑手配备三到五匹马，而非更换骑手。骑手每行军两小时就换乘另一匹马，使单匹马得到休息，这样可以连续行军十二小时以上，日行距离达一百二十公里。
蒙古马体型矮小但耐力极强，能在零下四十度环境中以雪代水、刨雪觅草。换马策略让每匹马实际负重时间减少六成，避免肌肉疲劳导致的速度下降，同时备用马可携带额外补给和战利品。
欧洲军队习惯使用体型更大的单一战马，在长途行军中因马匹疲劳而速度骤降。蒙古军队常利用这一差异实施佯退战术，诱使对手追击至马力耗尽后反击，这种战术在多瑙河战役中尤为明显。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　蒙古马与欧洲战马体型对比图示
cards.qe: How many times did Mongol horses change riders per day?
cards.shorte: Mongol cavalry changed horses, not riders
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ. Size comparison between Mongol horses and European warhorses
bodye: Mongol military mobility relied on each rider having three to five horses, not changing riders. Riders switched mounts every two hours of travel, allowing individual horses to rest while maintaining over twelve hours of continuous movement, covering up to 120 kilometers daily.

Mongol horses were small but exceptionally hardy, surviving temperatures of minus forty degrees by eating snow for water and pawing through it for grass. The rotation strategy reduced each horse's actual carrying time by sixty percent, preventing muscle fatigue while spare horses carried additional supplies and plunder.

European armies typically used single, larger warhorses that rapidly slowed during long marches due to exhaustion. Mongol forces exploited this difference through feigned retreat tactics, luring pursuers until their mounts were spent before counterattacking—a strategy particularly evident in Danube River campaigns.
cards.query: Mongol horse Equus caballus historical illustration

cards.q: 圆周率小数点后哪位数字出现最少？
cards.short: 前万亿位各数字频率无显著差异
body: 计算圆周率前 10 万亿位小数，0 到 9 十个数字各出现约 1 万亿次，频率差异在千分之一以内。尚未发现哪个数字显著偏少或偏多，分布接近理想均匀状态。
若圆周率是正规数（normal number），则任意长度的数字串在无限位中出现频率应趋于相等。目前数值证据强烈支持这一猜想，但严格数学证明尚未完成。
早期仅计算数百位时曾观察到局部偏差，例如前 100 位中 7 出现 8 次而 1 出现 8 次。但样本扩大到百万位以上后，所有数字频率迅速趋于 10% 附近，偏差随位数增加而缩小。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　圆周率前十万亿位各数字出现频率
cards.qe: Which digit appears least in decimal expansion of pi?
cards.shorte: All digits occur equally in first trillion places
bodye: Computing the first 10 trillion decimal places of pi, each digit 0–9 appears roughly 1 trillion times, with frequency variance under one part per thousand. No digit shows significant scarcity or excess; distribution approaches ideal uniformity.

If pi is a normal number, any finite digit string should appear with equal asymptotic frequency. Numerical evidence strongly supports this conjecture, though rigorous mathematical proof remains incomplete.

Early calculations of a few hundred digits showed local bias—e.g., in the first 100 digits, 7 and 1 each appear 8 times. Expanding samples beyond a million digits drives all frequencies rapidly toward 10%, with variance shrinking as digit count grows.
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Digit frequency in first ten trillion places of pi
cards.query: pi digits distribution histogram mathematical chart

cards.q: 莎士比亚发明了多少英语单词？
cards.short: 莎翁未发明多少新词
body: 传统说法称莎士比亚发明了约1700个英语单词，但现代语料库研究显示，这些词的大部分在他之前已有记录，只是他的作品恰好是现存最早的印刷文献。
16至17世纪印刷术普及前，大量口语词汇未被书面记录。莎士比亚作品的广泛出版使其成为许多词汇的最早可查文献来源，但这不等同于发明。语言学家估计他真正创造的新词不超过数十个。
真正的语言创新者往往是无名使用者。词汇演化是集体过程，作家的贡献在于记录和推广而非凭空创造。将文献首现等同于发明是对语言史的常见误读。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　威廉·莎士比亚肖像版画
cards.src: The Oxford English Dictionary Historical Corpus
cards.qe: How many English words did Shakespeare invent?
cards.shorte: Shakespeare coined few words
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Engraved portrait of William Shakespeare
bodye: Traditional claims credit Shakespeare with inventing around 1,700 English words, but modern corpus research shows most existed before him. His works simply provide the earliest surviving printed documentation.

Before printing became widespread in the 16th-17th centuries, many spoken words went unrecorded. Shakespeare's published works became the earliest traceable source for numerous terms, but this differs from invention. Linguists estimate he genuinely coined fewer than several dozen words.

True language innovators are typically anonymous users. Vocabulary evolution is a collective process; writers contribute through documentation and popularization rather than creation ex nihilo. Equating first documentation with invention is a common misreading of linguistic history.
cards.srce: The Oxford English Dictionary Historical Corpus
cards.query: William Shakespeare Droeshout engraving First Folio

cards.q: 哪种语言的字母表最长？
cards.short: 高棉语字母表最长
body: 高棉语字母表共有74个字母，是世界上字母数量最多的文字系统。其中包括33个辅音字母、23个元音符号及其他附加符号，远超拉丁字母的26个。
高棉文字源于古印度婆罗米文字，在传播过程中吸收了大量梵语和巴利语的音位系统。为精确表达这些外来音节，字母数量不断扩充，形成了复杂的拼写规则。
字母数量多并不意味着语言更复杂。汉语没有字母表，阿拉伯语仅28个字母，但这些语言的表达能力丝毫不弱。文字系统的设计反映的是历史选择而非语言优劣。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　高棉文字母表手稿
cards.qe: Which language has the longest alphabet?
cards.shorte: Khmer alphabet longest
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Manuscript of Khmer alphabet chart
bodye: The Khmer alphabet contains 74 letters, making it the world's largest alphabetic writing system. It includes 33 consonants, 23 vowel symbols, and additional diacritics, far exceeding Latin's 26 letters.

Khmer script derives from ancient Indian Brahmi script and absorbed phonetic systems from Sanskrit and Pali during transmission. To accurately represent these foreign phonemes, the letter count expanded, creating complex orthographic rules.

More letters do not indicate greater language complexity. Chinese has no alphabet, Arabic has only 28 letters, yet these languages possess equal expressive power. Writing system design reflects historical choices rather than linguistic superiority.

cards.q: 为什么洋葱切开后会让人流泪？
cards.short: 洋葱细胞破损释放催泪物质
body: 洋葱细胞被切割时，其中的蒜氨酸酶与硫化物前体接触，在数秒内合成丙硫醛-S-氧化物。该气体分子量仅162，极易挥发并扩散至空气中。
丙硫醛-S-氧化物接触眼球表面后，与泪液中的水反应生成硫酸。角膜神经感受到刺激后，触发三叉神经反射，泪腺在约0.3秒内开始分泌泪液稀释刺激物。
冷藏洋葱可降低酶活性，减少催泪因子生成速度。在流水下切洋葱或使用锋利刀具破坏更少细胞，也能明显减轻流泪反应。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　洋葱催泪因子的生成与作用路径
cards.qe: Why do onions make you cry when cut?
cards.shorte: Onions release tear-inducing compounds when cells rupture
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Formation and action pathway of onion lachrymatory factor
bodye: When onion cells are cut, the enzyme alliinase contacts sulfur compound precursors, synthesizing syn-propanethial-S-oxide within seconds. This gas has a molecular weight of only 162, making it highly volatile and airborne.

Upon contact with the eye surface, syn-propanethial-S-oxide reacts with tear fluid water to form sulfuric acid. Corneal nerves sense the irritation and trigger trigeminal reflexes; lacrimal glands begin secreting tears within about 0.3 seconds to dilute the irritant.
Refrigerating onions reduces enzyme activity, slowing lachrymatory factor production. Cutting under running water or using sharp knives to damage fewer cells also significantly reduces tearing.

cards.q: 伦敦大火之后重建用了多久？
cards.short: 伦敦大火后四年基本重建完成
body: 1666年伦敦大火烧毁约13200座房屋和87座教堂，重建在1670年已基本完成。政府颁布《重建法案》规定必须使用砖石代替木材，房屋按街道等级分为四种标准高度。
速度快的原因是产权清晰且激励到位。火灾调查法庭快速裁定产权纠纷，地主若在三年内未重建将失去土地。建筑材料实行免税，砖厂和采石场产能在一年内扩大三倍。
克里斯托弗·雷恩提出的巴洛克式棋盘规划未被采用。市政当局选择在旧街道格局上重建，因征地补偿成本过高且会使商户长期失去营业地点。圣保罗大教堂的重建则用了35年。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　1666年伦敦大火前后城区对比
cards.src: The Rebuilding of London After the Great Fire
cards.qe: How long did it take to rebuild London after the Great Fire?
cards.shorte: London largely rebuilt four years after the Great Fire
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　London before and after the 1666 Great Fire
bodye: The 1666 Great Fire destroyed about 13,200 houses and 87 churches. Rebuilding was largely complete by 1670. The Rebuilding Act mandated brick and stone instead of timber, with four standardized building heights according to street rank.

Clear property rights and strong incentives accelerated reconstruction. Fire courts rapidly resolved disputes. Landowners forfeited land if they failed to rebuild within three years. Building materials were tax-exempt, and brick kilns tripled capacity within a year.

Christopher Wren's proposed Baroque grid plan was rejected. Authorities rebuilt on the old street pattern because land acquisition costs were prohibitive and would have displaced merchants for years. St. Paul's Cathedral took 35 years to rebuild.
cards.srce: The Rebuilding of London After the Great Fire

cards.q: 罗马的喷泉用水从何而来？
cards.short: 罗马喷泉至今使用古代水道供水
body: 罗马约有2000座喷泉，其中许多仍由古罗马时期修建的水道供水。特雷维喷泉使用处女水道，该水道建于公元前19年，每日输送约8万立方米水。水源位于城外12公里处。
水道利用纯重力输水，坡度约为千分之三至千分之五。路线经过精确测量以维持稳定流速，部分段落使用虹吸原理跨越山谷。喷泉位置选在水道地势较高点，利用水压形成喷射。
现代罗马并未关闭古水道另建管网。水道在16至17世纪经历修复，石砌渠道被部分替换为铅管和陶管，但路线和水源保持不变。这些水道同时为部分街区提供饮用水。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　罗马处女水道路线示意图
cards.qe: Where does the water for Rome's fountains come from?
cards.shorte: Rome's fountains still use ancient aqueduct water
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ　Route of the Aqua Virgo aqueduct in Rome
bodye: Rome has about 2,000 fountains, many still supplied by ancient Roman aqueducts. The Trevi Fountain uses the Aqua Virgo, built in 19 BCE, delivering roughly 80,000 cubic meters daily from a source 12 kilometers outside the city.

The aqueducts use pure gravity flow with gradients of 0.3 to 0.5 percent. Routes were precisely surveyed to maintain steady flow. Some segments employ siphons to cross valleys. Fountains are positioned at high points to utilize water pressure for jets.

Modern Rome did not shut down ancient aqueducts for new networks. They were restored in the 16th and 17th centuries, with some stone channels replaced by lead and terracotta pipes, but routes and sources remain unchanged. These aqueducts also supply drinking water to some districts.

cards.q: 维京人的角盔来自何处？
cards.short: 角盔是浪漫主义虚构
body: 考古发现的所有维京头盔均无角装饰，已出土的完整头盔如约克郡头盔和耶夫讷头盔都是简单的圆顶或带护鼻的铁盔。维京时代（公元800至1050年）的艺术品、符文石碑和同时期编年史均未显示带角头盔。这一形象首次大规模流行源自1876年瓦格纳歌剧《尼伯龙根的指环》的舞台服装设计。
角盔形象可能混淆了青铜时代的仪式用角盔，这些头盔确实存在于北欧，但年代早于维京时代一千五百年以上，且明确用于宗教仪式而非战斗。战斗中佩戴带角头盔会增加重量、破坏平衡并提供额外的打击把手，属严重战术劣势。
浪漫主义运动将日耳曼民族理想化，艺术家为增强视觉冲击而添加夸张元素。这一虚构形象通过插图书籍、电影和流行文化传播至今。类似的文化误读还包括哥伦布证明地球是圆的这一神话，实则古希腊时代已有共识。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　真实维京头盔与流行文化形象对比
cards.qe: Where did the horned Viking helmet come from?
cards.shorte: Horned helmets are Romantic fiction
bodye: All archaeologically recovered Viking helmets lack horn decorations. Intact examples like the Coppergate helmet and Gjermundbu helmet are simple rounded or nasal-guarded iron caps. Viking Age art (800–1050 CE), runestones, and contemporary chronicles show no horned helmets. This image first gained widespread popularity from costume designs for Wagner's 1876 opera Der Ring des Nibelungen.

The horned helmet image likely conflates Bronze Age ceremonial horned helmets, which did exist in Northern Europe but predate the Viking Age by over fifteen hundred years and were explicitly ritual objects, not combat gear. Wearing horned helmets in battle would add weight, disrupt balance, and provide convenient grab handles—a severe tactical disadvantage.

The Romantic movement idealized Germanic peoples, with artists adding exaggerated elements for visual impact. This fictional image persists through illustrated books, films, and popular culture. Similar cultural misreadings include the myth that Columbus proved Earth was round, when ancient Greeks had already reached consensus.

cards.q: 斐波那契数列第100个数有几位？
cards.short: 斐波那契第100项为21位数
body: 斐波那契数列第100个数是354224848179261915075，共21位数字。这个数列增长极快，第10项仅55，第50项已达12位数，第100项则超过千亿亿。
数列每项是前两项之和，增长率逐渐趋近黄金分比1.618。项数每增加约5项，数字位数增加1位。这种指数式增长使数值迅速膨胀，远超直觉。
许多人误以为数列增长是线性的，但实际增速比复利更猛。第200项已达42位数，第1000项则达到209位，远超宇宙中原子总数。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　斐波那契数列前15项增长曲线（归一化）
cards.src: The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences
cards.qe: How many digits are in the 100th Fibonacci number?
cards.shorte: The 100th Fibonacci number has 21 digits
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Growth curve of the first 15 Fibonacci numbers (normalized)
bodye: The 100th Fibonacci number is 354,224,848,179,261,915,075, containing 21 digits. The sequence grows rapidly: the 10th term is merely 55, the 50th reaches 12 digits, and the 100th exceeds a hundred quintillion.

Each term equals the sum of the previous two, with growth rate approaching the golden ratio 1.618. Roughly every 5 terms, the number gains one digit. This exponential growth creates values far beyond intuition.
Many assume linear growth, but the actual rate exceeds compound interest. The 200th term has 42 digits, and the 1,000th reaches 209 digits—far more than atoms in the observable universe.

cards.q: 为什么帕玛森干酪能保存数年不坏？
cards.short: 帕玛森含水量低至三成可长存
body: 正宗帕玛森干酪（Parmigiano-Reggiano）含水量仅30%左右，远低于普通奶酪的45-55%。一公斤成品需约16升鲜奶，经过压榨与陈化，水分被大量排出。
低水分使微生物无法繁殖，同时高盐度（约1.6%）和高酸度进一步抑制腐败。陈化过程中蛋白质分解为游离氨基酸，形成结晶颗粒，质地变得坚硬而易碎。
许多人以为靠防腐剂保存，实际传统工艺完全不添加。轮形奶酪重达40公斤，外壳厚实隔绝空气，切开前可在恒温库存放36个月以上。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　帕玛森干酪轮形成品与切面结晶
cards.srcMeta: 意大利帕玛森奶酪协会 / 2023
cards.qe: Why can Parmesan cheese last for years without spoiling?
cards.shorte: Parmesan's 30% moisture content enables long storage
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Parmigiano-Reggiano wheel and crystalline cross-section
bodye: Authentic Parmigiano-Reggiano contains only 30% moisture, far below the 45-55% typical of common cheeses. One kilogram requires about 16 liters of fresh milk, with water expelled through pressing and aging.

Low moisture prevents microbial growth, while high salt (1.6%) and acidity further inhibit spoilage. During aging, proteins break down into free amino acids, forming crunchy crystals and a hard, brittle texture.
Many assume preservatives are used, but traditional methods add none. Each wheel weighs 40 kilograms, with a thick rind sealing out air, allowing storage for over 36 months before cutting.

cards.q: 为什么黄油在冰箱里仍能涂抹？
cards.short: 黄油多种脂肪混合不会完全凝固
body: 黄油含有超过400种不同脂肪酸，熔点从零下40℃到40℃不等。冷藏温度4℃时，部分脂肪仍保持液态或半固态，使黄油维持可塑性。
纯脂肪在熔点以下会完全硬化，但混合脂肪形成连续相变区间。黄油中约65%是饱和脂肪，35%是不饱和脂肪，后者即使低温也不结晶，起到天然增塑剂作用。
人造黄油常用氢化植物油，脂肪组成单一，冷藏后往往变得坚硬难涂。天然黄油的复杂成分反而赋予更好的低温柔韧性，无需回温即可使用。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　黄油脂肪酸组成示意图
cards.qe: Why does butter remain spreadable in the refrigerator?
cards.shorte: Butter's mixed fats prevent complete solidification
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Composition diagram of butter fatty acids
bodye: Butter contains over 400 different fatty acids with melting points ranging from -40°C to 40°C. At refrigeration temperature of 4°C, some fats remain liquid or semi-solid, maintaining plasticity.

Pure fats solidify completely below their melting point, but mixed fats create a continuous phase transition zone. Butter's 65% saturated and 35% unsaturated fats—the latter staying non-crystalline even cold—act as natural plasticizers.

Margarine often uses hydrogenated vegetable oil with uniform composition, turning hard when chilled. Natural butter's complex mix provides better low-temperature flexibility, requiring no warming before use.

cards.q: 为什么陈皮要放三年才能用？
cards.short: 陈皮挥发油三年内逐渐降解转化
body: 新鲜橘皮含挥发油高达5%，主要成分柠檬烯具刺激性，直接入药易伤脾胃。陈化三年后挥发油降至2%以下，同时生成陈皮素等温和成分，药性转为平和。
陈化过程中，果皮细胞壁分解，苦味黄酮苷水解为游离黄酮，溶解度提高十倍。通风干燥环境下，每年翻晒2-3次，促进氧化与酯化反应，形成特有陈香。
许多人误以为越陈越好，但超过十年后有效成分开始分解流失。广东新会陈皮传统要求三年起用，五至十年为最佳，过度陈化反而药效下降。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　陈皮挥发油含量随陈化年份变化
cards.qe: Why must dried tangerine peel age for three years before use?
cards.shorte: Tangerine peel's volatile oils gradually transform over three years
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Volatile oil content in aged tangerine peel over time
bodye: Fresh orange peel contains up to 5% volatile oils, mainly limonene, which irritates the digestive system. After three years of aging, volatile oils drop below 2%, while gentle compounds like tangeretin form, moderating medicinal properties.

During aging, cell walls break down and bitter flavonoid glycosides hydrolyze into free flavonoids with tenfold higher solubility. In ventilated dry conditions, turning and sun-drying 2-3 times yearly promotes oxidation and esterification, creating characteristic aroma.

Many assume older is always better, but after ten years active compounds begin degrading. Xinhui tangerine peel tradition requires three years minimum, with five to ten years optimal; excessive aging reduces efficacy.

cards.q: 纽约中央公园的土是原地的吗？
cards.short: 中央公园大部分土壤为外地运入
body: 中央公园建造时运入约50万立方米客土，相当于20万卡车的量。原址是沼泽与岩石地，土壤贫瘠且排水不良，设计师奥姆斯特德从新泽西等地调运肥沃表土。
公园种植了超过2.6万棵树木，需要深厚土层支撑根系。施工队先爆破岩石、填平洼地，再铺设60-120厘米厚的种植土，并埋设排水管网总长约90公里。
许多人以为只是平整原有地形，实际地表整体抬高了1-3米。现存的天然岩石露头都是刻意保留，作为景观对比，占地面积不足总面积的5%。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　中央公园建造前岩石沼泽地貌
cards.srcMeta: 美国中央公园保护协会 / 2021
cards.qe: Is the soil in Central Park original to the site?
cards.shorte: Most of Central Park's soil was brought from elsewhere
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Rocky swampland before Central Park construction
bodye: Central Park's construction involved importing 500,000 cubic meters of soil—equivalent to 200,000 truckloads. The original site was swampy with bedrock, featuring poor soil and drainage. Designer Olmsted hauled fertile topsoil from New Jersey and beyond.

The park's 26,000-plus trees required deep soil to support roots. Crews blasted rock, filled depressions, then laid 60-120 cm of planting soil, embedding drainage pipes totaling 90 kilometers in length.

Many assume the terrain was merely leveled, but the surface was actually raised 1-3 meters. Natural bedrock outcrops were deliberately preserved as landscape contrast, covering less than 5% of the total area.

cards.q: 世界上使用人口最少的文字是什么？
cards.short: 中国女书使用者已不足十人
body: 女书是中国湖南江永县女性专用文字，使用者在2020年统计时仅剩5位高龄妇女。这种音节文字约有700个字符，专门记录当地方言，用于女性之间传递私密情感。
女书产生于约500年前，源于女性被排斥在汉字教育之外。字形纤细斜长，多书写在扇面、帕巾上，内容包括婚嫁诗歌、诉苦信函等，形成封闭的传承圈。
许多人以为已经失传，实际仍有研究者记录整理，并培训年轻传承人。但作为日常交流工具，女书功能已被普通话与汉字取代，自然使用者几乎绝迹。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　女书手写扇面文本实物
cards.src: UNESCO Atlas of the World's Languages in Danger
cards.qe: What is the world's least-used writing system by population?
cards.shorte: China's Nüshu script has fewer than ten users
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Nüshu handwritten fan text artifact
bodye: Nüshu is a women-only script from Jiangyong County, Hunan, with only 5 elderly female users remaining as of 2020. This syllabary of 700 characters recorded local dialect, conveying private emotions among women.

Nüshu emerged around 500 years ago, born from women's exclusion from Han character education. Its slender, slanted glyphs adorned fans and handkerchiefs, documenting wedding songs and grievance letters within a closed circle of inheritors.

Many assume it vanished, but researchers continue documentation and train young inheritors. Yet as a daily communication tool, Nüshu has been replaced by Mandarin and Han characters, with natural users nearly extinct.

cards.q: 吉萨金字塔建造时大象已灭绝了吗？
cards.short: 金字塔建成时北非象刚灭绝数百年
body: 吉萨大金字塔建于公元前2560年左右，而北非象在埃及的灭绝时间约为公元前3000年，两者相隔仅400多年。气候干旱化与人类狩猎加速了象群消失。
古埃及艺术中几乎不见大象形象，但苏丹南部与埃塞俄比亚仍有象群。法老时代埃及人从努比亚进口象牙，说明象已不在本土生存，需远距离贸易获取。
许多人以为金字塔时代还有大象可驱使，实际当时埃及主要役畜是牛和驴。罗马时期北非象短暂复现，被用于竞技表演，但公元4世纪后再次绝迹。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　古埃及浮雕中的努比亚象牙贡品
cards.src: The Oxford History of Ancient Egypt
cards.qe: Were elephants already extinct when the Giza pyramids were built?
cards.shorte: North African elephants went extinct centuries before the pyramids
cards.fige: Plate Ⅰ: Nubian ivory tribute in ancient Egyptian relief
bodye: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built around 2560 BCE, while North African elephants in Egypt vanished around 3000 BCE—a gap of just over 400 years. Climate aridification and hunting accelerated herd disappearance.

Ancient Egyptian art rarely depicts elephants, though herds persisted in southern Sudan and Ethiopia. Pharaonic Egyptians imported ivory from Nubia, indicating elephants no longer lived locally and required long-distance trade.

Many assume pyramid-era Egypt had elephants to command, but the main draft animals were cattle and donkeys. North African elephants briefly reappeared in Roman times for arena spectacles, then vanished again after the 4th century CE.

cards.q: 太阳每秒释放多少能量？
cards.short: 太阳每秒释放四亿亿兆焦耳能量
body: 太阳核心每秒通过核聚变将约六亿吨氢转化为氦，这一过程释放的能量约为3.8×10²⁶焦耳。这个数字相当于全球人类文明年消费能量的一百万倍。
根据爱因斯坦质能方程，核聚变过程中约四百万吨质量转化为纯能量。这些能量以光子形式从核心向外传播，需要数万年才能抵达太阳表面，再用八分钟到达地球。
地球接收到的太阳能量仅占其总辐射的二十二亿分之一。即便如此，这些能量已足够驱动地球上几乎所有天气系统、洋流和生命活动。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　太阳核心聚变区域剖面图
cards.qe: How much energy does the Sun release per second?
cards.shorte: The Sun releases 3.8×10²⁶ joules per second
bodye: The Sun's core converts approximately 600 million tons of hydrogen into helium every second through nuclear fusion, releasing about 3.8×10²⁶ joules of energy. This equals one million times humanity's annual energy consumption.

According to Einstein's mass-energy equation, about four million tons of mass convert to pure energy during this fusion process. Energy photons take tens of thousands of years to travel from the core to the surface, then eight minutes to reach Earth.
Earth receives only one two-billionth of the Sun's total energy output. Yet this fraction alone powers nearly all weather systems, ocean currents, and life processes on our planet.

cards.q: 金星的自转方向和其他行星相反吗？
cards.short: 金星自转方向与其他行星相反
body: 金星是太阳系中唯一自东向西逆向自转的大行星，其他七颗行星均自西向东旋转。金星自转一周需要约243个地球日，而公转周期仅225个地球日，导致其一天比一年还长。
主流理论认为金星早期曾遭受一次或多次大型天体撞击，改变了原有自转方向。另一种假说指出金星浓密大气层与太阳引力潮汐的长期作用可能逐步减慢并逆转了自转。
由于逆向自转，金星上太阳从西方升起，东方落下。但因金星表面被厚重云层永久遮蔽，实际上无法直接看到太阳的升落。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　金星表面地形雷达成像图
cards.qe: Does Venus rotate in the opposite direction to other planets?
cards.shorte: Venus rotates backward compared to other planets
bodye: Venus is the only major planet in the solar system that rotates east to west, opposite to the other seven planets. One Venusian rotation takes about 243 Earth days, while its orbital period is only 225 Earth days, making a day longer than a year.

The leading theory suggests Venus experienced one or more massive impacts early in its history that reversed its original rotation. An alternative hypothesis proposes that Venus's thick atmosphere and solar tidal forces gradually slowed and reversed its spin over time.

Due to retrograde rotation, the Sun rises in the west and sets in the east on Venus. However, the planet's surface is permanently shrouded by thick clouds, making direct observation of sunrise or sunset impossible.
cards.query: Venus surface Magellan radar topography map

cards.q: 画中圣母的长袍为何总是蓝色？
cards.short: 群青颜料曾贵过黄金
body: 群青颜料源自阿富汗青金石，为文艺复兴画作中最昂贵色料，价格常超过等重黄金。
青金石唯一产地为阿富汗巴达赫尚矿区，运输与提纯耗时费工，画家常在合同中注明蓝袍用量以示委托人财力与虔诚。
群青因此成为地位象征，画家往往先以廉价的德国蓝或黑色打底，再薄涂群青，并非满幅厚涂。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　青金石原矿与研磨颜料对照
cards.qe: Why is the Virgin Mary's robe always painted blue?
cards.shorte: Ultramarine once cost more than gold
cards.fige: Plate I: Raw lapis lazuli beside its ground ultramarine pigment
bodye: Ultramarine, ground from Afghan lapis lazuli, was the costliest pigment in Renaissance painting, often priced above gold of equal weight.
The only source was the Sar-e-Sang mines in Badakhshan, and processing was slow and laborious, so patrons and painters specified the pigment's use in contracts as a sign of piety and wealth.
Because of its price, painters often underpainted robes in cheaper blue or black, then applied ultramarine only as a thin glaze rather than solid coverage.
cards.srce: Bright Earth: Art and the Invention of Color
cards.query: lapis lazuli mineral ultramarine pigment photograph

cards.q: 《夜巡》画的真是夜晚吗？
cards.short: 《夜巡》实为白日场景
body: 伦勃朗1642年所绘《夜巡》是一幅宽逾四米的巨型民兵连群像，现藏阿姆斯特丹国立博物馆，画面描绘的是白天场景。
画面阴影方向、光线角度符合日光特征，19至20世纪积累的深色清漆与烟尘使底色转暗，才形成了「夜巡」的俗称。
1715年画作迁入市政厅时四边被裁切，左侧约损失60厘米并去掉两名民兵，现只能从17世纪临摹本得见原貌。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　《夜巡》清洗修复后的日光场景细部
cards.src: 阿姆斯特丹国立博物馆「夜巡行动」修复项目
cards.srcMeta: 荷兰阿姆斯特丹，2019年至今
cards.qe: Does The Night Watch actually depict nighttime?
cards.shorte: The Night Watch actually shows daylight
cards.fige: Plate I: A cleaned detail of The Night Watch showing its daylight setting
bodye: Rembrandt's 1642 group portrait, popularly called The Night Watch, spans more than four meters wide and hangs in the Rijksmuseum; despite its nickname, the scene it depicts unfolds in daylight.
The shadows and light in the painting match a daytime scene. Layers of darkened varnish and soot, built up over the 19th and 20th centuries, dimmed the surface enough to earn the misleading nickname.
When the painting moved to Amsterdam's town hall in 1715, all four edges were trimmed, roughly 60 centimeters from the left alone, removing two militiamen now known only from a 17th-century copy.
cards.srce: Rijksmuseum, Operation Night Watch Restoration Project

cards.q: 一位画家被控通敌，靠什么脱罪？
cards.short: 画家当庭作画自证清白
body: 荷兰画家范梅赫伦1942年将自绘伪作《基督与行淫的女子》冒充维米尔真迹卖给纳粹戈林；1945年战后他因通敌罪被捕，最高可判死刑。
为避死罪，他当庭承认全为己作，并由法庭指派证人监督，用同类颜料与做旧手法重现一幅「新维米尔」以自证造假。
最终他仅以伪造罪获刑一年，未及服刑便病逝；而他的伪作曾骗过当时最权威的维米尔鉴定专家。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　范梅赫伦本人肖像照
cards.qe: How did a painter accused of treason clear his name?
cards.shorte: He forged a Vermeer in court to prove his innocence
cards.fige: Plate I: A portrait photograph of Han van Meegeren
bodye: In 1942 the Dutch painter Han van Meegeren sold his own forged Vermeer, Christ and the Woman Taken in Adultery, to Nazi official Hermann Goring. After the war, in 1945, he was arrested for collaboration, selling a national treasure to the enemy, a charge that could carry the death penalty.

To escape that charge, he confessed the painting was entirely his own work, then, under court-appointed supervision, recreated a new Vermeer-style forgery using the same aged pigments and techniques to prove it.
He was ultimately convicted only of forgery and sentenced to one year, but died before serving it. His forgeries had fooled the leading Vermeer experts of his day.

plate.ti: 最终获刑
plate.unit: 年监禁，因伪造罪判处，未及服刑便病逝
plate.unite: year in prison for forgery, he died before serving it
plate.note: 原被控通敌罪最高可判死刑
plate.notee: The treason charge he escaped could have carried the death penalty
plate.imgTitle: Portrait of a Man by Han van Meegeren Rijksmuseum Amsterdam SK-A-4243.jpg

cards.q: 米开朗基罗画西斯廷天顶时是躺着的吗？
cards.short: 西斯廷天顶画站立完成
body: 米开朗基罗1508至1512年绘制西斯廷礼拜堂天顶画，历时四年，他站在自己设计的木制脚手架上完成，并非仰卧。
脚手架靠墙壁高处预留的孔洞与支架悬挑而成，不落地面，既不影响礼拜堂下方使用，也让他能仰头站立绘制穹顶。
他曾写诗自嘲颈椎变形、胡须朝天、颜料滴落满面，晚年读信须举至头顶——躺卧作画的说法多源自后世影视演绎。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　西斯廷礼拜堂天顶湿壁画全景
cards.src: 《米开朗基罗：艺术家、凡人与他的时代》
cards.qe: Did Michelangelo paint the Sistine ceiling lying on his back?
cards.shorte: The Sistine ceiling was painted standing up
cards.fige: Plate I: A full view of the Sistine Chapel ceiling fresco
bodye: Michelangelo painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling between 1508 and 1512, working for four years while standing on a wooden scaffold of his own design, not lying on his back.
The platform was cantilevered from brackets set into holes high on the walls rather than resting on the floor, so it never blocked the chapel below and let him work upright with his head tilted back.

In a satirical poem, he described a twisted neck, a beard pointing skyward, and paint dripping onto his face, and said he later had to hold letters overhead to read them. The lying-down image comes mostly from later films.
cards.srce: Michelangelo: The Artist, the Man, and His Times

plate.note: 脚手架搭于墙洞支架，未落地面

cards.q: 土星光环有多厚？
cards.short: 光环最薄处不足十米
body: 土星环系统直径约28万公里，接近地月距离的四分之三，但主环最薄区域厚度估计仅十米左右。
环内冰粒不断碰撞，每次碰撞都会抵消垂直方向的运动，只保留同一平面内的公转，久而久之颗粒轨道被压扁进一条窄带。
由于环体极薄，随着土星公转，每隔约十五年会出现环面几乎侧对地球的时刻，望远镜中的光环因此近乎隐形，最近一次发生在2025年前后。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　卡西尼号拍摄的土星环侧视光带
cards.src: 土星环掩星观测粒径研究
cards.qe: How thick are Saturn's rings, really?
cards.shorte: Ring's thinnest point is under ten meters
cards.fige: Plate I. Cassini's edge-on view of Saturn's ring band
bodye: Saturn's ring system spans roughly 280,000 kilometers, nearly three-quarters of the Earth-Moon distance, yet its thinnest stretch may be only about ten meters thick.
Repeated collisions among the icy particles cancel out vertical motion, leaving orbits confined to a single plane, which flattens the rings into a narrow band over time.
Because the rings are so thin, roughly every fifteen years Saturn's orbit brings them edge-on to Earth, making them nearly vanish through telescopes, most recently around 2025.

plate.tie: Thickness of Saturn's rings at their thinnest

plate.notee: The rings span about 280,000 km yet are thinner than a ten-story building
plate.imgTitle: Top view of the rings of Saturn by Cassini - October 10, 2013.jpg

cards.q: 北极星永远都是北极星吗？
cards.short: 北极星并非固定不变
body: 地球自转轴像陀螺一样缓慢摆动，一周约需2.6万年，现在最靠近北天极的北极星，正随之逐渐偏离原本位置。
月亮和太阳对地球赤道隆起部分的引力牵引，使自转轴像陀螺受扰时那样画出一个圆锥，天极因此在星空中缓慢移动。
古埃及人建造金字塔时，对准的北极星是天龙座的右枢，而非现在这颗；约一万二千年后，织女星将接替成为新的北极星。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　长时间曝光下呈同心圆轨迹的北天极星轨
cards.qe: Will Polaris always be the North Star?
cards.shorte: Polaris will not stay put forever
cards.fige: Plate I. Long-exposure star trails circling the north celestial pole
bodye: Earth's rotation axis wobbles slowly like a spinning top, completing one full circle roughly every 26,000 years, so the current pole star, Polaris, is gradually drifting from its position.
Gravitational pull from the Sun and Moon on Earth's equatorial bulge drags the axis into a cone-shaped path, much like a nudged gyroscope, slowly shifting the celestial pole across the sky.
When Egyptians built the pyramids, the star marking true north was Thuban in Draco, not today's pole star; in about twelve thousand years, Vega will take over as the new North Star.

plate.tie: Time for one full axial precession cycle
plate.note: 约合人类文字记录历史的五倍时长
plate.notee: Roughly five times the span of recorded human history

cards.q: 太阳系外的天体真会闯入吗？
cards.short: 首个星际天体访客现身
body: 2017年，夏威夷泛星望远镜发现一颗掠过太阳系的天体奥陌陌，轨道呈双曲线，说明它并非本系统成员，而是外来过客。
凡是引力束缚的天体轨道都是椭圆，奥陌陌的轨道离心率却大于一，太阳只能令它转向，却无法把它留住，它终将一去不回。
天文学家早就推测星际天体应当存在，却直到2017年才首次观测到；奥陌陌加速轨迹一度引发飞船猜测，多数学者仍倾向彗星式挥发解释。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　奥陌陌掠过内太阳系的艺术想象图
cards.src: 奥陌陌轨道异常加速研究
cards.qe: Can an object from beyond the solar system really drop in?
cards.shorte: First interstellar visitor confirmed
cards.fige: Plate I. Artist's impression of Oumuamua crossing the inner solar system
bodye: In 2017, Hawaii's Pan-STARRS telescope spotted an object called Oumuamua sweeping through the solar system on a hyperbolic path, marking it as a visitor from beyond, not a native resident.
Any object bound by the Sun's gravity follows an ellipse, but Oumuamua's orbit had an eccentricity above one, so the Sun could only bend its path, not capture it; it will leave and never return.

Astronomers had long predicted such interstellar visitors, but none was confirmed until 2017; a brief, unexplained acceleration sparked talk of artificial origin, though most favor comet-like outgassing.
cards.srce: Study of Oumuamua's anomalous orbital acceleration

cards.q: 冥王星和卡戎谁才是中心？
cards.short: 冥王星与卡戎互绕运行
body: 卡戎质量约为冥王星的八分之一，是太阳系中卫星与主星质量之比最大的一对，两者质心因此落在冥王星地表之外。
两颗星体绕共同质心公转，周期约6.4天，且都已被彼此潮汐锁定，从冥王星表面某点看，卡戎几乎悬停不动。
地月系统里只有月球单向锁定地球，冥王星却双向锁定；假如站在冥王星背对卡戎的一面，将永远看不到这颗卫星。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　新视野号拍摄的冥王星与卡戎合照
cards.src: 新视野号冥王星系统研究
cards.qe: Between Pluto and Charon, which one is the center?
cards.shorte: Pluto and Charon orbit one another
cards.fige: Plate I. New Horizons' portrait of Pluto and Charon together
bodye: Charon's mass is about one-eighth of Pluto's, the largest moon-to-primary ratio of any round-body pair in the solar system, so their shared center of mass lies in space beyond Pluto's surface.
Rather than Charon circling a stationary Pluto, both bodies orbit that shared point every 6.4 days, and each is tidally locked to the other, so Charon hovers almost motionless in Pluto's sky.
Unlike Earth and the Moon, where only the Moon is locked, Pluto is locked to Charon too; standing on Pluto's far side, facing away from Charon, one would never see it at all.

plate.note: 质心落在冥王星地表之外的太空中
plate.notee: The barycenter sits in open space beyond Pluto's surface

cards.q: 人类怎么「看见」系外行星？
cards.short: 首颗系外行星靠摆动现身
body: 1995年，两位瑞士天文学家确认飞马座51b，是首颗环绕类日恒星的系外行星，公转周期仅4.2天，比水星近得多。
行星本身太暗难以直接看到，天文学家转而测量恒星光谱线的周期性红移蓝移，那是行星引力拉扯恒星摆动留下的痕迹。
当时的行星形成理论认为，气态巨行星只应诞生在远离恒星之处，这颗近距离气态行星的发现改写了理论，两人于2019年获诺贝尔物理学奖。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　飞马座51b与母恒星的艺术想象图
cards.qe: How did astronomers first detect a planet they could never actually see?
cards.shorte: First exoplanet found through starlight wobble
cards.fige: Plate I. Artist's impression of 51 Pegasi b and its host star
bodye: In 1995, two Swiss astronomers confirmed 51 Pegasi b, the first exoplanet found orbiting a Sun-like star; it circles its star in just 4.2 days, far closer than Mercury orbits the Sun.
The planet itself was too faint to see directly, so astronomers instead measured periodic shifts in the star's spectral lines, the telltale wobble caused by the planet's gravity tugging on its star.

Planet-formation theory at the time held that gas giants should only form far from their star; this close-orbiting giant forced a rethink, and the discovery earned its authors the 2019 Nobel Prize in Physics.

plate.ti: 母恒星径向速度的周期性摆动
plate.imgTitle: Artist impression of the exoplanet 51 Pegasi b.jpg

cards.q: 世界上最长寿的脊椎动物是谁？
cards.short: 格陵兰鲨可活四百余年
body: 2016年《科学》期刊用眼球晶状体放射性碳测定格陵兰鲨年龄，最大个体估算超过270岁，最高可能达500岁左右。
极地深海水温接近零度，格陵兰鲨代谢速率极低，细胞损伤积累缓慢，是其罕见长寿的关键机制之一。
它性成熟要到150岁左右才开始，终生体型增长缓慢，游速全球鲨鱼中垫底，长寿反而伴随近乎静止的生活节奏。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　格陵兰鲨在北极深海缓游的资料照片。
cards.qe: Which vertebrate lives the longest?
cards.shorte: Lives past four centuries
cards.fige: Plate I. A documentary photograph of a Greenland shark swimming slowly in Arctic deep water.
bodye: In 2016, the journal Science used eye-lens radiocarbon dating to age Greenland sharks; the largest individual was estimated at over 270 years, possibly near 500.
Near-freezing deep Arctic water gives the shark an extremely slow metabolism, slowing cellular damage — a likely key to its rare longevity.
Sexual maturity arrives around age 150; growth stays slow for life, and it swims slower than nearly any shark — longevity paired with near stillness.

plate.ti: 格陵兰鲨估算寿命
plate.note: 放射性碳测定给出约272至512岁的区间
plate.notee: Radiocarbon dating gives a range of roughly 272 to 512 years

cards.q: 哪种哺乳动物长着毒刺？
cards.short: 雄兽后腿藏毒刺
body: 雄性鸭嘴兽后肢各有一根中空毒刺，连接腿部毒腺，是现存少数会分泌毒液的哺乳动物之一。
毒液在繁殖季分泌浓度明显升高，主要用于雄性间争夺配偶的搏斗，而非用来捕食或防御天敌。
人类中毒后极少致命，但剧痛可持续数周，常规止痛药大多无效，具体镇痛机制至今未完全阐明。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　鸭嘴兽的博物学版画。
cards.qe: Which mammal has venomous leg spurs?
cards.shorte: Males hide venom in leg spurs
cards.fige: Plate I. A natural-history engraving of the platypus.
bodye: Male platypuses carry a hollow spur on each hind leg linked to a venom gland — one of the few living mammals that produce venom.
Venom concentration rises sharply during breeding season; males use it in fights over mates rather than for hunting or defense against predators.
Human stings are rarely lethal but cause pain lasting weeks that resists most standard painkillers; the exact pain mechanism is still unclear.

cards.q: 步甲虫为何能喷出沸腾液体？
cards.short: 腹内混合两液瞬间沸腾
body: 投弹甲虫腹部两个腺室分别储存对苯二酚与过氧化氢，遇袭时混合催化，喷出接近100摄氏度的化学液体。
两种液体经酶催化剧烈放热反应，压力将灼热喷雾以脉冲方式高速射出，甲虫还能转动腹部精准瞄准目标。
反应室内壁具备耐高温结构，甲虫自身不会被腹内近沸点液体灼伤，喷射后可迅速补充化学储备再次防御。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　投弹甲虫喷射化学防御液的资料照片。
cards.srcMeta: 康奈尔大学 Eisner 团队，1969年
cards.qe: Why can bombardier beetles spray boiling-hot liquid?
cards.shorte: Two fluids flash-boil inside
cards.fige: Plate I. A documentary photograph of a bombardier beetle discharging its chemical spray.
bodye: Bombardier beetles store hydroquinones and hydrogen peroxide in separate abdominal chambers; under attack the two mix and react, ejecting fluid near 100°C.
Enzymes catalyze a violently exothermic reaction; pressure fires the hot spray in rapid pulses, and the beetle can rotate its abdomen to aim precisely.
The reaction chamber's lining withstands the near-boiling fluid without harming the beetle, which quickly rebuilds its chemical reserves for another defense.

plate.note: 腹部两种化学物质混合引发瞬间放热反应
plate.notee: Caused by an instant exothermic reaction when two abdominal chemicals combine

cards.q: 北美林蛙结冰后为何还能复活？
cards.short: 体内产生天然抗冻剂
body: 北美林蛙越冬时体温降至零下，体内可达六成水分结冰，心跳与呼吸完全停止，仍可在春季解冻后复苏。
结冰前，林蛙肝脏大量分解糖原释放葡萄糖，如同天然防冻液渗入细胞，防止冰晶刺穿细胞膜结构。
真正结冰的只是细胞间隙的水分，细胞内部靠高浓度糖分维持不结冰，这才是它能存活的关键区别。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　北美林蛙的野外生态摄影。
cards.srcMeta: 卡尔顿大学 Storey 实验室，1984年
cards.qe: How does a wood frog revive after freezing solid?
cards.shorte: Its body brews natural antifreeze
cards.fige: Plate I. A field ecology photograph of the wood frog.
bodye: In winter, wood frogs let body temperature drop below freezing; up to 60% of body water turns to ice, heartbeat and breathing stop, yet spring brings revival.
Before freezing, the liver breaks down glycogen into glucose that floods the cells like a natural antifreeze, keeping ice crystals from piercing membranes.
Only the water between cells actually freezes; high sugar concentration keeps water inside cells from freezing — the real reason the frog survives.

cards.q: 巨魔芋为何会发热又发臭？
cards.short: 发热助气味远播传粉
body: 巨魔芋开花时中央肉穗温度可升高至接近人体体温，比周围环境高出不少，同时释放类似腐肉的硫化物气味。
花序细胞线粒体高速氧化脂肪供能产热，这种代谢速率可与飞行中的蜂鸟相当，是植物界罕见的产热方式。
发热并非为了保暖，而是让恶臭分子更容易挥发扩散，专门吸引食腐甲虫与丽蝇替它传粉。
cards.fig: 图版 Ⅰ　巨魔芋开花时肉穗结构的植物学摄影。
cards.qe: Why does the titan arum heat up and reek?
cards.shorte: Heat helps its stench travel far
cards.fige: Plate I. A botanical photograph of the titan arum's spadix in bloom.
bodye: When the titan arum blooms, its central spadix can warm to near human body temperature, well above ambient air, while releasing sulfurous, carrion-like odors.
Mitochondria in the flower's cells rapidly oxidize fat for heat at a metabolic rate comparable to a hovering hummingbird — rare for a plant.
The heat isn't for warmth; it helps the stench molecules evaporate and spread further, drawing in carrion beetles and blowflies to pollinate it.
cards.srce: Botanical Journal of the Linnean Society
